limits: All five jobs completed successfully in the final attempt; this artifact audit certifies only the headless current visual images lane (53 checks, the state after the review of PR #66).

The preceding-host control (all 53 checks run, the 40 normative ones fail) and the four retained sabotages (2, 3, 8 and 2 failures) remain local evidence; this audit only shows that every check they fail and still exist passes in the hosted run. The hosted job runs the images example headless (test:examples) but not its capture lane with the native renderer (39 checks, whose pixel samples saw the shader draw). The headless renderer draws no pixel, so the hosted run certifies, like the local one, what the view asked the renderer for and the exact pixels of the blur by the bitmap the worker made.
Bundle hashes and the native host hash are declared by the runner; no bundle or native binary is included in the artifact.
CI host hash is not required to equal the local built host.
Mobile and parity jobs are separate: only their PASSED markers are recorded, their outputs are not audited here.
Git-tree verification establishes tracked content at the pushed main checkout; it does not independently inspect a compiled native binary.
The slice's own committed limits are unchanged and still apply, except the one that says hosted CI had not run the slice, which this receipt supersedes (the rest of that limit still applies):

The renderer of a headless run is Godot's dummy, which draws no pixel and ignores the parameters of a material: the probe and the oracle certify what the view asked the renderer for (rectangles, radii, margins, tint, the item and the material it made) and the exact pixels of the blur by the bitmap the worker made; only the example's capture lane saw the shader draw

The capture lane samples a few points of the saved frame (the icon's dot, ring, body and corner, the soft and the sharp landscape at the sun's edge and in the sky, the card's border at two places of both cards, the avatars' corner, edge and centre, and the second avatar's border and round corner); there is no independent pixel oracle of the whole frame

No comparison with UIKit was made: the blur's box and rounding, the tiling of a nine-patch, the resizable image under the other content modes and the template rendering were not compared on an iOS device

A blur at the content scale of a picture whose box is wider than the picture (radius 30 at scale 3 on a 36x27 pixel picture) was checked against the oracle's own blur; the blur of very large pictures and its time were not measured on a device

Animated GIF and WebP, nativeImageSource, defaultSource's placeholder, loadingIndicatorSource and fadeDuration's transition (which iOS does not have), resizeMethod and resizeMultiplier (Android's) are not delivered, and an Image inside Text is a failure by design
Assets and network pictures were loaded in the project's own run, against a loopback server; no exported app, desktop export or Android export ran
The oracle and the probe state values from what the host delivered or from model states, never from frame pace or from how bytes were segmented, and every wait is bounded by time and ends on a state
Only macOS arm64 was executed; Windows, Linux, Android, iOS and Web runtimes are not covered
GF-16 is open: this third slice closes no checkpoint, and no whole GF, contract, parity, target, weight or denominator closes.
